task_description.overview: Create graphical representations of earthquake focal mechanisms using moment tensor or strike-dip-rake parameters.
steps: Import the beachball plotting function from the ObsPy imaging module.
Define the moment tensor components or strike-dip-rake parameters.
Call the beachball function with the defined parameters and plotting options (size, line width, face color).
Render or save the plot for interpretation.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Generate beachball plots for the following focal mechanism parameters: 1) moment tensor {mt_list_1} with blue fill; 2) strike-dip-rake {mt_list_2} with red fill; 3) moment tensor {mt_list_3} with green fill. Use a plot size of 200 and line width of 2. param with `outfile` to save the plot. 
 Note: 1) Save the beachball plot 1 to {beachball_plot_1}, the beachball plot 2 to {beachball_plot_2}, and the beachball plot 3 to {beachball_plot_3}.
